As Facebook (Put) (FB) Valuation Declined, Brookside Capital Management Has Increased by $1.03 Million Its Stake; Marathon Capital Management Has Lifted Celgene (CELG) Stake
May 27, 2018 - By Winifred Garcia
Bain Capital increased its stake in Facebook Inc (Put) (FB) by 390.7% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Brookside Capital Management Llc bought 2,606 shares as the company’s stock declined 14.10% with the market. The hedge fund run by Bain Capital held 3,273 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.30M, up from 667 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Brookside Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Facebook Inc (Put) for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $535.28B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.54% or $1.01 during the last trading session, reaching $184.92. About 9.79 million shares traded. Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) has risen 8.48% since May 27, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 3.07% the S&P500.
Marathon Capital Management increased its stake in Celgene Corp (CELG) by 24.53% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Marathon Capital Management bought 4,195 shares as the company’s stock declined 19.30% with the market. The institutional investor held 21,295 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.22M, up from 17,100 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Marathon Capital Management who had been investing in Celgene Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $57.11 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.14% or $0.91 during the last trading session, reaching $78.63. About 4.78M shares traded. Celgene Corporation (NASDAQ:CELG) has declined 31.28% since May 27, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 42.83% the S&P500.
